title: Defined in the open
sub: The second film of From tables to decisions, the third series of Modern data basics: casual teaching cost, counted three ways in three tools, is defined once, near the data, with its owner, its words and its rules, as a Unity Catalog metric view the data project builds; dbt's MetricFlow does the same in the project; and Apache Ossie, an open format, lets a definition travel from one tool to another.
howto: The film is drawn on the intro's platform map, up close: dark navy, with its faint grid. Gold is what people agree on, here the definition of casual teaching cost; light blue is the platform and its structure; amber is a person's turn, a review or an approval; green a check that passes. The kilogram's story, from 1889 to 2019, is drawn in the warm light of its vault.
